providers.title: Polynomial-time unitary synthesis
providers.scope: A polynomial-time generated quantum oracle circuit over H, T, T*, CNOT with polynomial resources approximates every n-qubit unitary within diamond-norm distance 1/2 for a suitable Boolean oracle.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Spectral theorem for Hermitian matrices
providers.scope: Every Hermitian matrix has an orthonormal basis of eigenvectors with real eigenvalues, by maximizing the Rayleigh quotient.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Trace norm of Hermitian matrices
providers.scope: Variational formula, triangle inequality, contraction under partial trace, and ||aa* - bb*||_1 <= 2||a - b|| for unit vectors.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: From operator norm to diamond norm
providers.scope: A circuit implementing U with clean-workspace error delta has output channel within 2 delta of U in the diamond norm.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: State preparation
providers.scope: u + 1 programmable slots prepare any family of unit vectors on u qubits, controlled by labels.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Basis permutations
providers.scope: 5u slots with u clean temporary qubits apply any family of permutations of the computational basis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Fourier transforms
providers.scope: The Fourier transform on b qubits is a fixed circuit of 2b + 3 floor(b/2) slots.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A matrix sign estimate
providers.scope: E||sum eps_i L_i|| <= 2 h^(1/2a) sqrt((2a - 1)v) for Hermitian h x h matrices L_i, v = ||sum L_i^2||, independent random signs.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A block of small norm
providers.scope: Permutations, diagonal signs and Walsh-Hadamard transforms bring every unitary of order d to a block form with internal block of norm at most 3/4 and size s >= d/(4M).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The number of reductions
providers.scope: Fewer than 8M(n+1) removals of the internal block reach dimension one.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Closing the internal coordinates
providers.scope: F = A + BZ(I - DZ)^-1 C is unitary for every diagonal unitary Z, and FE* = R*V.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Nearly isometric field maps
providers.scope: The truncated field maps satisfy (1 - r^2L) I <= T*T <= I and intertwine V with the controlled F(z) up to 2 r^L/(1 - r).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Row sparsity
providers.scope: In Fourier coordinates every row of both field maps has at most L nonzero entries, because power sums determine multisets.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Row-sparse nearly isometric maps
providers.scope: A map with at most L nonzero entries per row and (1 - eps) I <= T*T <= I is applied by slots and amplitude amplification with error at most 5 eps.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The field encoders
providers.scope: The two field maps are implemented by slot circuits with error at most 5 r^2L.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: One synthesis step
providers.scope: One call of a circuit for the controlled smaller unitaries F(z), between the two encoders, synthesizes V with an added error 2 r^L/(1 - r) + 10 r^2L.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Uniform programmable synthesis
providers.scope: A uniformly generated skeleton with t + O((n+1)^10) qubits and O((n+1)^13) slots solves every controlled synthesis task with error below 1/100.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Density of determinant-one words
providers.scope: The determinant-one words in H, T, T* are dense in SU(2).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Short words
providers.scope: Every element of SU(2) is within xi of a determinant-one word of length at most K_w xi^-3.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Exact controlled symbols
providers.scope: With clean scratch, the doubly controlled Z, the Toffoli gate and the singly controlled H, T, T* are exact circuits over H, T, T*, CNOT.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Compilation of slots
providers.scope: A skeleton of S slots is compiled into a circuit with one Boolean oracle storing approximating words, with error at most S eta and polynomial resources.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Proof of the synthesis theorem
providers.scope: The compiled recursion gives clean-workspace error below 1/50 and diamond-norm error below 1/25.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
